svg.title: paddock: who is waiting
svg.desc: Recorded from paddock 0.5.0 in a scratch tmux server; staged sessions. Shows a window dot turns red or blue, and the agents tab says who. Steps: 1. You are in api; two more agents work in the background. 2. web needs an answer: its dot turns red. 3. tests is done: its dot turns blue. 4. paddock shows who is waiting and who is done.
